core_principles: Fusion: Fitness Precision x Streetwear Edge
Gamification: Gold is the bridge between Sweat and Style
Density: High-density data for habits, low-density art for shopping
Motion: Fluid feedback on every interaction
anti_patterns: No gradient overload - use solid, punchy colors
No boring lists - use cards and grids
No 'Inter' everywhere - mix weights and tracking

instructions_to_main_agent.theme_implementation: Create a 'ThemeContext.js' that provides the current theme object (colors, spacing) to all components. Use 'useColorScheme' from react-native to detect system preference but allow manual override.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling_strategy: DO NOT use inline styles. Use StyleSheet.create(). For dynamic theme styles, return a function from the stylesheet or use the ThemeContext to inject colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout_rules: Use Flexbox. Default to 'flexDirection: column'. Use 'SafeAreaView' from 'react-native-safe-area-context' for all screens.
instructions_to_main_agent.navigation: Use 'expo-router' (tabs for main nav, stack for details). Customize the TabBar to float with a blur effect if possible (using expo-blur), or just a solid color matching the Surface color.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add 'testID' props to all interactive elements (Buttons, Inputs, List Items) using kebab-case (e.g., 'login-button', 'habit-card-steps').

dashboard.description: Top section: Large Circular Progress for 'Today's Goal'. Middle section: 2x2 Grid for specific habits (Water, Sleep, etc.). Bottom section: Recent Activity list.
dashboard.styles: Use standard spacing (16px) between grid items. Habits cards should be square-ish.

shop.description: 2-column grid. Product image takes 70% of card height. Price and Title below. 'Buy' button is small icon or text link.
shop.styles: Gap 12px. Card background depends on theme (White vs Dark Grey).

product_detail.description: Full-width image carousel at top (40% screen height). Title, Price, Description in a scrollable bottom sheet or view. Floating 'Add to Cart' button at bottom.
product_detail.styles: Use 'ScrollView'. Ensure text has enough padding (24px).

universal_guidelines: Always use the ThemeContext for colors.
Never hardcode dimensions for screen width/height - use 'Dimensions' or percentages.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44 points.
Handle empty states gracefully with an icon and text.
